about: Cross-category prompts for `carousearch eval`. Each names the plan properties a good plan has (agent/evals.py, PLAN_CHECKS); the checks are generic, the prompts are not. `carousearch eval` lists them; `carousearch eval --live` runs each once for real (planner, Carousell, worker).

prompts.name: phones_under_benchmark
prompts.prompt: Find used iPhone 15 Pro listings priced at least 20% below the typical asking price for the same storage size.

prompts.name: office_chair_budget
prompts.prompt: Best ergonomic office chair under S$250: lightly used or better, adjustable lumbar support and armrests, from a seller with good reviews.

prompts.name: neglected_cameras
prompts.prompt: Find mirrorless camera bodies that have been listed for a long time with few likes, where the seller might take a lower offer.

prompts.name: console_variants
prompts.prompt: Compare asking prices of the Nintendo Switch variants (original, Lite, OLED, Switch 2) and show the best-value listing of each.

prompts.name: owner_r15_benchmark
prompts.prompt: Find the average market price of the r15 motorcycle (well used and second hand), then take 80% of that as the market benchmark, then filter on top of that for blurry or low-effort images and COE of about 2 years, to find a bike priced 50% below the benchmark.

prompts.name: owner_motorcycles_below_median
prompts.prompt: Find used motorcycles priced well below the market median for the same model, show how many days each has been listed, and flag the ones with blurry or low-effort photos.

prompts.name: vague_request
prompts.prompt: Something nice for my new flat, not too expensive.
